Title: Verify Incremental Cuff Inflation Step Size and Maximum Limit
Prerequisites: Device powered with fresh AA alkaline batteries.
CardioTrack CT-200 cuff connected to calibrated digital pressure standard [PROPOSED SETUP].
Steps: Wrap cuff around adult test cylinder (arm circumference 22-32 cm).
Initiate blood pressure measurement sequence by depressing START.
Simulate absent pulse signal at 180 mmHg baseline pressure threshold.
Record sequential pressure inflation steps up to upper measurement limit.
ExpectedResult: If the user's pulse is not detected by 180 mmHg, the device inflates in 40 mmHg increments up to a maximum of 299 mmHg before aborting with an error.
PassFailCriteria: PASS if inflation increases by exactly 40 mmHg per step up to 299 mmHg. FAIL if increment differs from 40 mmHg or exceeds 299 mmHg.
StandardRef: CT-200 Manual Section 3.2 Cuff Inflation Sequence
